items.title: The grid becomes a target
items.text: Russia strikes power infrastructure across Ukraine with 84 cruise missiles and 24 drones. By 19 November about 10 million people were without electricity, according to President Zelenskyy.
items.source: Wikipedia: Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure

items.title: Kakhovka dam destroyed
items.text: The Russian-held Kakhovka dam is breached, flooding the lower Dnipro. Many experts concluded Russian forces likely blew it up; Russia denies this.
items.source: Wikipedia: Destruction of the Kakhovka Dam

items.title: Dams and power plants hit
items.text: A massive strike leaves more than a million people without power; missiles hit the Dnipro dam in Zaporizhzhia and Kharkiv's largest power plants. On 11 April the Trypilska plant near Kyiv is destroyed.
items.source: Wikipedia: Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure

note: Strikes on Ukraine's energy system and dams, October 2022 to 2024. Hand-entered by Orbis; each card names the article or record it was checked against (Wikipedia articles as retrieved on 2026-10-14, text paraphrased). Dates are Gregorian. Built by tools/build/ua_events.py.
